warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-4-5 at 1.00 + 2.00 + 1.10 + 2.90 (7.00); y = A-B-C-D at 1.00 + 2.00 + 3.00 (6.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01 (both views), S-02 (both views), A-03 (floor + roof plan) and A-06/A-07 and all agree. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page at zoom.
Section 4 rule 4: 4' (5.60, S-01/A-03 sub-chain 1.50 + 1.40, beam B1 sits on it), 1' (-1.00) and D' (7.00) (roof overhangs printed on S-02 roof framing and the A-03 roof plan).

Two dummies are NOT printed and were scaled from the grid (section 4 Span amendment, beam-endpoint rule): 3' (4.00) and 5' (8.00) — the ends of the 2C-150x50x20x3.2 steel roof members (row-A overhang on the +3.79 plan; rows B, C, D to the right roof edge). Both sit exactly where every printed overhang of this roof sits (1.00 past the outer grid), and both agree on S-02 and the A-03 roof plan; they carry their own confidence 0.7 and the beam segments that end on them are span_source scaled_from_grid.

Not lines: the top edge of the left roof part and of the ลานซักล้าง ground slab GS (about 1.00 beyond row A between grids 1'-3' / 3-5) and the step in the left roof edge (about 1.00 below row C at x = 1') have no printed dimension and no beam ending on them — no dummy invented; they are described in the element notes only.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-06/A-07, A-01 notes). The mono-pitch steel roof rises from row A to row D: ring beams top +3.64 / +3.79 / +3.91, roof members +4.16 (row C) and +4.53 (row D); A-06 prints the 0.89 step (+3.64 to +4.53) and A-07 the 0.74 step (+3.79 to +4.53). Every level shares the printed label ระดับหลังคานหลังคา, so the ids carry the value to stay unique.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-05 plus A-03 (floor plan + roof plan) and A-06/A-07 (building sections). Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: A-04/A-05 elevations, A-08 bathroom enlargement + fixture heights, A-09 door/window sizes (kept on the schedule elements), E-01, SN-01, SN-02. S-03..S-05 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes and depths, section sizes, slab thicknesses, step riser/tread), which stay on their elements.
